RAZI-FULL:v28p212#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p212#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p212#2/r1.claim: Rāzī supplies an omitted قال: they are told, This is the fire that you used to deny.
RAZI-FULL:v28p212#2/r1.anchor: ثم قال تعالى : { هاذه النار التى كنتم بها * تكذبون } على تقدير قال

STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r1.speaker: commentators
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r1.claim: Commentators agree that al-Ṭūr is Makkan, most likely from the latter half of the Makkan period.
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r1.anchor: commentators agree that al-Ṭūr is from the Makkan period, most likely from the latter half.

STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r2.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r2.claim: Some say Sūrah al-Ṭūr was revealed immediately after Sūrah 32, al-Sajdah.
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r2.anchor: According to some it was revealed immediately after Sūrah 32, al-Sajdah.

STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r3.claim: The sūrah is named for the Mount mentioned in its first verse; most understand al-Ṭūr as Mount Sinai wherever it appears in the Quran, while the full name occurs in 23:20 and 95:2.
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r3.anchor: name from the mention of the Mount

STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r4.claim: The opening half follows Sūrah 51 by treating the promised Day (51:60) and punishment for its wrongdoers and disbelievers (51:59–60); the sūrah affirms that promise (51:5, 51:22) and further warns of it.
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r4.anchor: the first half (vv. 1–28) focuses upon the subject of the concluding verse of that sūrah, the Day that they are promised (51:60

STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r5.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r5.claim: The sūrah begins with oaths and the coming punishment and Judgment, contrasts the deniers' fate with the reverent's reward, answers accusations against the Prophet, challenges deniers, and ends by counseling patience and praise of God.
STUDYQURAN:52:intro/r5.anchor: Al-Ṭūr begins with a series of oaths and a promise of God’s impending punishment and the Day of Judgment (vv. 1–10)

STUDYQURAN:52:14/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:14/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:52:14/r1.claim: This verse is comparable to 83:17 and resembles 77:29.
STUDYQURAN:52:14/r1.anchor: Cf. 83:17. This verse is similar to 77:29: Away to that which you used to deny!

STUDYQURAN:52:14/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:52:14/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:52:14/r2.claim: Verses 14–16 are understood as words spoken by angels to the inhabitants of the Fire.
STUDYQURAN:52:14/r2.anchor: Vv. 14–16 are understood to be uttered by the angels to the inhabitants of the Fire.

BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r17.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r17.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r17.claim: The statement is an address spoken by the keepers of the Fire.
BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r17.anchor: أي يقال لهم من قبل خزنة النار هذه النار

BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r18.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r18.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r18.claim: The preposition bihā attaches to tukadhdhibūn: they denied the revelation that spoke of this Fire.
BURSEVI:v9p155#2/r18.anchor: متعلق بقوله : {تكذبون} أي تكذبون الوحي الناطق بها

TABATABAI:52:11-15/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:52:11-15/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:52:11-15/r8.claim: They are told this is the fire whose existence and punishment of sinners the prophets conveyed by revelation, and which they denied.
TABATABAI:52:11-15/r8.anchor: والمراد بالتكذيب بالنار التكذيب بما أخبر به الأنبياء

TABATABAI:52:11-15/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:52:11-15/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:52:11-15/r9.claim: The fire now before them is the reality of what the prophets foretold.
TABATABAI:52:11-15/r9.anchor: هذه مصداق ما أخبر به الأنبياء فكذبتم به

TABRISI:52:9-16/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:52:9-16/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:52:9-16/r12.claim: Hell's keepers identify this as the fire they denied in worldly life.
TABRISI:52:9-16/r12.anchor: قال لهم خزنتها { هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون } في الدنيا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says they had denied this Fire in worldly life.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: أي في الدنيا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r2.claim: After the truth is exposed, they are reproached for the claims they made while denying it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p484/r2.anchor: ثم وبخوا بما كانوا يدعون في حال التكذيب قبل انكشاف الأمر

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:52:12-15/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:52:12-15/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:52:12-15/r3.claim: They are told that the Fire in front of them is the very punishment they had denied.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:52:12-15/r3.anchor: ويقال لهم: { هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون }

ELMALILI:52:1-16/r24.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:52:1-16/r24.speaker: author
ELMALILI:52:1-16/r24.claim: As they are shoved into the fire, they are told that this is the fire they used to deny.
ELMALILI:52:1-16/r24.anchor: Yani o gün böyle diyerek kakılacaklar

MAJAZ:v2p231/r2.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p231/r2.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p231/r2.claim: The phrase is compressed; its full form is fa-yuqālu hādhihi al-nār, then it is said: this is the Fire.
MAJAZ:v2p231/r2.anchor: «دعا هذه النار» (13- 14) مختصر مخرجه: فيقال: هذه النار..

NAHHAS:v4p253/r20.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p253/r20.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p253/r20.claim: A verb of saying is omitted: it is said to them, “This is the Fire you denied.”

ZAJJAJ:v5p62/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p62/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p62/r3.claim: The phrase is spoken to them with an understood introductory verb: it will be said to them, this is the fire you denied.
ZAJJAJ:v5p62/r3.anchor: هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r1.claim: Islahi says this exegesis seeks to prevent Orientalist, Jewish, and extremist Shiite mischief, and that attentive readers will be protected from it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r1.anchor: People who will carefully read it, will inshā’Allāh remain protected from the mischief of the Orientalists, the Jews and extremist Shiites.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r2.claim: Islahi says the Qur’an’s present arrangement was set by God and His Prophet, and is based on religious philosophy and divine-law wisdom rather than history, as with the Torah and Gospel.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r2.anchor: The Qur’ ān we have today has been arranged by God and His Prophet (sws).

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r3.claim: He holds that all Qur’anic groups are linked and each sūrah is closely tied to its predecessor; changing its placement would create a void in meaning.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r3.anchor: Every sūrah is so deeply linked to the previous one that a slight change in its placement will create void in the meanings.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r4.claim: Within each sūrah, verses cohere under a central theme; removing even one risks damaging the sequence.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r4.anchor: all the verses of a sūrah are so closely connected to another that even if one verse is removed from its current place

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r5.claim: The established mutawātir reading is the one in the current muṣḥaf, and Islahi bases his verse and word interpretations on that reading.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r5.anchor: The conventional and mutawātir reading is the one written in this muṣḥaf which is in our hands today.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r6.claim: He interprets each verse and word through Arab usage, discourse context, and Qur’anic parallels, saying this leaves no doubt.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r6.anchor: the language of the Arabs, the context of the discourse and parallels of the Qur’ ān in such a manner that no doubt remains.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r7.claim: He argues that interpreting through other readings sacrifices the Qur’an’s eloquence, purpose, and wisdom.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p6/r7.anchor: interpreting the Qur’ān on the basis of other readings is only possible at the expense of sacrificing its eloquence, purpose and wisdom.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r1.claim: As the group’s third sūrah, al-Ṭūr follows Qāf and al-Dhāriyāt, which establish resurrection and judgment through intellectual, historical, inward, and outward proofs; those works present reward and punishment together.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r1.anchor: This is the third sūrah of this group.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r3.claim: Verses 1–16 introduce a severe warning to obstinate Quraysh, adducing historical and universal facts, insisting punishment cannot be hastened or averted, then depicting Judgment and deniers’ fate.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p9/r3.anchor: a vivid picture of the Day of Judgement, with a brief description of the dreadful fate of those who had denied it.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p18/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p18/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p18/r7.claim: After their worldly pranks, they will be driven forcefully to Hell and told that this is the Fire they mocked and denied.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p18/r7.anchor: it will be said to them that this was the Hell they would make fun of and reject in the previous world.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p569/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p569/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p569/r1.claim: After being told that this is Hell, the deniers are confronted with two possible sources of doubt: magic changing what they see or a defect in their own vision; they are ordered into it as a reproach.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p569/r1.anchor: لما قيل لهم ذلك، وقفوا بعد ذلك على الجهتين اللتين يمكن دخول الشك في أنها النار، وهي: إما أن يكون سحر يلبس ذات المرئي،

ALUSI-FULL:v27p30#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p30#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p30#2/r1.claim: On that day it will be said this is the Fire they denied; denial means rejecting revelation that speaks of it.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p30#2/r1.anchor: أي فيقال لهم ذلك ( يوم ) الخ ومعنى التكذيب بها تكذيبهم بالوحي الناطق بها

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p387#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p387#2/r5.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p387#2/r5.claim: The guards tell them that this is the Fire they used to deny in worldly life.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p387#2/r5.anchor: {هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون} في الدنيا

BAYDAWI-FULL:52:14-17/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:52:14-17/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:52:14-17/r1.claim: These words are spoken to the people being punished.
BAYDAWI-FULL:52:14-17/r1.anchor: هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون

BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r8.claim: The fire is a burning body that destroys what it touches and occupies its victims’ attention, unlike their former play.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r8.anchor: الجسم المحرق المفسد لما أتى عليه

BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r9.claim: Their denial of the fire was extreme, the root of their other denials, and repeated continually in worldly life; fronting بها highlights that particular denial.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p295/r9.anchor: ولما كان تكذيبهم بها في أقصى درجات التكذيب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r4.claim: The statement beginning هذه النار is quoted speech with its verb omitted; context supplies 'it is said to them,' spoken by the angels escorting them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r4.anchor: وجملة { هذه النار } إلى آخرها مقول قول محذوف دل عليه السياق . والقول المحذوف يقدر بما هو حال من ضمير { يدعون }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r5.claim: The near feminine demonstrative implies that they have reached the edge of Hell and prepares for what follows through لا تبصرون.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r5.anchor: والإشارة بكلمة { هذه } الذي هو للمشار إليه القريب المؤنث تومىء إلى أنهم بلغوها وهم على شفاها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r6.claim: The relative clause exposes the error of denying resurrection and punishment, which they now see directly.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p43/r6.anchor: والموصول وصلته في قوله : { التي كنتم بها تكذبون } لتنبيه المخاطبين على فساد رأيهم إذ كذبوا بالحشر والعقاب فرأوا ذلك عيانا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p186#2/r23.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p186#2/r23.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p186#2/r23.claim: The speech has an omitted introductory phrase: they are told, 'This is the Fire'; the announcement rebukes and reproaches them.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p186#2/r23.anchor: وفي الكلام محذوف مختصر تقديره: يقال لهم هذه النار، وإخبارهم بهذا على جهة التوبيخ

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p49#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p49#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p49#2/r1.claim: This is the Fire that they used to deny in worldly life.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p49#2/r1.anchor: هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون في الدنيا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p431/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p431/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p431/r1.claim: The keepers of Hell say this to the deniers as a rebuke and reproach.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p431/r1.anchor: أي: تقول لهم الزبانية ذلك تقريعا وتوبيخا

MUQATIL:52:11-14/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:52:11-14/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:52:11-14/r2.claim: After judgment, Hell's keepers shackle disbelievers' hands to their necks, bind forelocks to feet behind their backs, and push them face-first into Hell, where they are told this is the fire they denied.
MUQATIL:52:11-14/r2.anchor: خزنة جهنم بعد الحساب يغلون بأيدى الكفار إلى أعناقهم، ثم يجمعون نواصيهم إلى أقدامهم، وراء ظهروهم، ثم يدفعونهم في جهنم دفعا

NASAFI-FULL:v4p183#14/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p183#14/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p183#14/r1.claim: The Fire is the one they used to deny in the worldly life.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p183#14/r1.anchor: ﴿ هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون ﴾ في الدنيا

QURTUBI-FULL:52:13-16/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:52:13-16/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:52:13-16/r3.claim: The keepers identify this as the Fire the condemned denied in worldly life.
QURTUBI-FULL:52:13-16/r3.anchor: فإذا دنوا من النار قالت لهم الخزنة: { هذه النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون } في الدنيا
